metadata.title: The homology cobordism group is not generated by graph homology $3$-spheres
metadata.abstract: We show the homology cobordism group of homology $3$-spheres is not generated by graph homology $3$-spheres. Our technique is a combination of filtered instanton Floer theory and Gromov's simplicial volume.
metadata.comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Comments are welcome

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 证明整数同调三球面的同调配边群不能由图流形同调三球面生成。
techniques: 过滤瞬子 Floer 同调
analysis.breakthrough: 为图流形之外的同调配边结构给出新的生成阻碍。
